import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {LOCAL_TASK_DRAFT_SLOT} from '../shared/local-task-draft';
import {constants,type BigIntStats} from 'node:fs';
import {mkdir,open,rename,rm,type FileHandle} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {readScreenBrief} from '../core/screen-brief';
import {parseModuleAnswer} from '../core/interactive-modules';
import type {Task} from '../core/types';
import {MODULE_MIME} from '../shared/module-contract';
import {helperDraftMode,isHelperDraftSlot} from '../shared/helper-draft-slots';
import {helperStudio} from '../learning/reusable-helper';
import {semanticHelper} from '../learning/semantic-helper';
import {WINDOW_WORKFLOW_MIME,readWindowWorkflowCandidate} from '../shared/window-workflow-artifact';
import {joinRowDraftSlot,windowReviewCandidateId,parseJoinRowRaw,parseWindowReviewRaw,windowReviewRawMatches} from '../shared/learning-draft-form-policy';
import {isTaskLearningDraftOwner,learningDraftTaskId,learningDraftJsonPolicy,learningDraftUsesExtendedCapacity,parseLearningDraftJson,serializeLearningDraftJson} from '../shared/learning-drafts';
import {LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS,learningDraftKey,parseLearningDraftEpoch,parseLearningDraftFile,parseLearningDraftOwner,parseLearningDraftRecoveryToken,parseLearningDraftSlot,parseLearningDraftTaskId,parseLearningDraftValue,type LearningDraftCleanupResult,type LearningDraftFile,type LearningDraftOwner,type LearningDraftReadResult,type LearningDraftRecord,type LearningDraftRecoverResult,type LearningDraftSaveResult,type LearningDraftValue} from '../shared/learning-drafts';

const unavailableMessage='Unfinished practice could not be read. Its saved bytes have been preserved.';
const hasCode=(error:unknown,code:string)=>error instanceof Error&&'code' in error&&error.code===code;
type Options={directory:string;lookupTask:(taskId:string)=>Promise<Task|undefined>};
type Loaded={kind:'available';file:LearningDraftFile}|{kind:'unavailable';message:string;recoveryToken?:string};
type DraftSource=Buffer|{recoveryToken:string};
const digest=(bytes:Buffer)=>createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
const parseBytes=(bytes:Buffer)=>parseLearningDraftFile(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(bytes)));
const readFlags=constants.O_RDONLY|constants.O_NOFOLLOW|constants.O_NONBLOCK;
const oversizedToken=(info:BigIntStats)=>createHash('sha256').update('learning-drafts:oversized:v1\0').update(JSON.stringify([info.dev,info.ino,info.size,info.mtimeNs,info.ctimeNs].map(value=>value.toString()))).digest('hex');
const recoveryChanged=()=>Error('Unreadable practice has changed. Read its current status before trying recovery again.');

/** A host-owned sidecar for raw local editing values, separate from committed task state. */
export class LearningDraftStore{
 private queue:Promise<unknown>=Promise.resolve();
 private readonly path:string;
 constructor(private readonly options:Options){this.path=join(options.directory,'learning-drafts.json');}
 private serialize<T>(action:()=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>{const result=this.queue.then(action);this.queue=result.catch(()=>{});return result;}
 private async readSource():Promise<DraftSource|null>{
  let file;
  try{file=await open(this.path,readFlags);}
  catch(error){if(hasCode(error,'ENOENT'))return null;throw error;}
  try{
   const info=await file.stat({bigint:true});if(!info.isFile())throw Error('Draft file is invalid.');
   if(info.size>BigInt(LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.fileBytes))return {recoveryToken:oversizedToken(info)};
   const buffer=Buffer.alloc(LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.fileBytes+1);let bytesRead=0;
   while(bytesRead<buffer.length){const next=await file.read(buffer,bytesRead,buffer.length-bytesRead,bytesRead);if(next.bytesRead===0)break;bytesRead+=next.bytesRead;}
   if(bytesRead>LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.fileBytes)throw Error('Draft file is too large.');
   return buffer.subarray(0,bytesRead);
  }finally{await file.close();}
 }
 private async load():Promise<Loaded>{
  try{
   const bytes=await this.readSource();if(bytes===null)return {kind:'available',file:{schemaVersion:2,epoch:'initial',records:[]}};
   if(!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes))return {kind:'unavailable',message:unavailableMessage,recoveryToken:bytes.recoveryToken};
   try{return {kind:'available',file:parseBytes(bytes)};}
   catch{return {kind:'unavailable',message:unavailableMessage,recoveryToken:digest(bytes)};}
  }catch{return {kind:'unavailable',message:unavailableMessage};}
 }
 private async invalidSource(token:string):Promise<DraftSource>{
  const source=await this.readSource();
  if(source!==null){
   if(!Buffer.isBuffer(source)){if(source.recoveryToken===token)return source;}
   else if(digest(source)===token){try{parseBytes(source);}catch{return source;}}
  }
  throw recoveryChanged();
 }
 private async copyOversized(token:string,backup:FileHandle):Promise<void>{
  const source=await open(this.path,readFlags);
  try{
   const before=await source.stat({bigint:true});
   if(!before.isFile()||before.size<=BigInt(LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.fileBytes)||oversizedToken(before)!==token)throw recoveryChanged();
   const buffer=Buffer.alloc(64*1024);let copied=0n;
   while(true){
    const {bytesRead}=await source.read(buffer,0,buffer.length,null);if(bytesRead===0)break;
    copied+=BigInt(bytesRead);if(copied>before.size)throw recoveryChanged();
    await backup.writeFile(buffer.subarray(0,bytesRead));
   }
   if(copied!==before.size||oversizedToken(await source.stat({bigint:true}))!==token)throw recoveryChanged();
  }finally{await source.close();}
 }
 private async survivingRecords(records:readonly LearningDraftRecord[]):Promise<LearningDraftRecord[]>{
  const tasks=new Map<string,boolean>(),retained:LearningDraftRecord[]=[];
  for(const record of records){
   if(!isTaskLearningDraftOwner(record.owner)){retained.push(record);continue;}
   const taskId=record.owner.taskId;
   if(!tasks.has(taskId)){
    const task=await this.options.lookupTask(taskId);
    if(task!==undefined&&task.id!==taskId)throw Error('Task lookup returned another identity.');
    tasks.set(taskId,task!==undefined);
   }
   if(tasks.get(taskId))retained.push(record);
  }
  return retained;
 }
 private async validTask(taskId:string):Promise<boolean>{return (await this.options.lookupTask(taskId))?.id===taskId;}
 private async validOwner(owner:LearningDraftOwner,slot:string,value:LearningDraftValue):Promise<boolean>{
  if(!isTaskLearningDraftOwner(owner))return slot===LOCAL_TASK_DRAFT_SLOT;
  const task=await this.options.lookupTask(owner.taskId);
  if(!task||task.id!==owner.taskId)return false;
  const artifact=task.artifacts.find(artifact=>artifact.id===owner.artifactId),revision=artifact?.revisions.find(item=>item.revision===owner.artifactRevision&&item.digest===owner.artifactDigest);
  if(!revision||revision.encoding==='base64')return false;
  if('kind' in owner){
   if(owner.kind==='workflow-source-review')return ['workflow-source:review','workflow-source:publication'].includes(slot)&&revision.mimeType.startsWith('text/');
   if(revision.mimeType!=='application/json'||!readScreenBrief(revision.content,revision.sourceRefs))return false;
   const candidateId=learningDraftUsesExtendedCapacity(value)?windowReviewCandidateId(slot):undefined;
   if(!candidateId)return true;
   try{
    const formBasis:unknown=JSON.parse(value.basis);
    if(!formBasis||typeof formBasis!=='object'||!('basis' in formBasis)||typeof formBasis.basis!=='string')return false;
    const ref:unknown=JSON.parse(formBasis.basis);
    if(!ref||typeof ref!=='object'||!('artifactId' in ref)||!('revision' in ref)||!('digest' in ref)||ref.artifactId!==candidateId)return false;
    const saved=task.artifacts.find(item=>item.id===candidateId)?.revisions.find(item=>item.revision===ref.revision&&item.digest===ref.digest);
    if(!saved||saved.mimeType!==WINDOW_WORKFLOW_MIME||saved.encoding==='base64')return false;
    if(value.basis!==serializeLearningDraftJson({basis:serializeLearningDraftJson({artifactId:candidateId,revision:saved.revision,digest:saved.digest}),variableArrays:[]}))return false;
    const candidate=readWindowWorkflowCandidate(saved.content,saved.sourceRefs),policy=learningDraftJsonPolicy(owner,slot);
    if(!candidate||candidate.provenance.taskId!==task.id||candidate.provenance.basis.artifactId!==owner.artifactId||candidate.provenance.basis.revision!==owner.artifactRevision||candidate.provenance.basis.digest!==owner.artifactDigest)return false;
    return [value.initial,value.value].every(text=>windowReviewRawMatches(parseWindowReviewRaw(parseLearningDraftJson(text,policy)),candidate));
   }catch{return false;}
  }
  if(revision.mimeType!==MODULE_MIME)return false;
  try{
   const answer=parseModuleAnswer(JSON.parse(revision.content)),module=answer.modules.find(item=>item.id===owner.moduleId&&item.version===owner.moduleVersion);if(!module)return false;
   const row=learningDraftUsesExtendedCapacity(value)?joinRowDraftSlot(slot):undefined;
   if(row){
    if(module.data.kind!=='join-lab'&&module.data.kind!=='grounded-join')return false;
    const table=(module.data.kind==='join-lab'?module.data.practice:module.data.extraction)[row.side];
    if(!table.rows.some(item=>item.id===row.rowId))return false;
    const policy=learningDraftJsonPolicy(owner,slot);
    return [value.initial,value.value].every(text=>parseJoinRowRaw(parseLearningDraftJson(text,policy)).cells.length===table.columns.length);
   }
   if(module.data.kind!=='helper-studio')return !isHelperDraftSlot(slot)&&['join-lab','grounded-join','workflow-lab'].includes(module.data.kind);
   const mode=helperDraftMode(slot);if(!mode||artifact?.revisions.at(-1)!==revision)return false;
   const matches=task.session?.moduleStates.filter(saved=>saved.artifactId===owner.artifactId&&saved.artifactRevision===owner.artifactRevision&&(saved.moduleId===owner.moduleId||(saved.moduleId===undefined&&answer.modules.length===1)))??[];
   if(matches.length>1)return false;
   // Slots are inert raw values. A write can have been admitted before another
   // mirror changed modes, so keep both named families recoverable here. Only
   // the matching renderer mode may present a slot as applicable.
   if(!matches.length)return true;
   const current=matches[0].state;
   if(current.format==='semantic-record-v1')semanticHelper.parseState(module.data.id,current);
   else helperStudio.parseState(module.data,current);
   return true;
  }catch{return false;}
 }
 private async write(file:LearningDraftFile,beforeReplace?:()=>Promise<void>):Promise<void>{
  const bytes=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(file));
  if(bytes.length>LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.fileBytes)throw Error('Unfinished practice storage is full.');
  await mkdir(this.options.directory,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});
  const temporary=join(this.options.directory,`.learning-drafts-${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
  try{
   const output=await open(temporary,'wx',0o600);
   try{await output.writeFile(bytes);await output.sync();}finally{await output.close();}
   await beforeReplace?.();
   await rename(temporary,this.path);
   await this.syncDirectory();
  }finally{await rm(temporary,{force:true});}
 }
 private async syncDirectory():Promise<void>{const directory=await open(this.options.directory,'r');try{await directory.sync();}finally{await directory.close();}}
 read():Promise<LearningDraftReadResult>{return this.serialize(async()=>{
  const loaded=await this.load();if(loaded.kind==='unavailable')return loaded;
  try{const records=await this.survivingRecords(loaded.file.records);return {kind:'available',epoch:loaded.file.epoch,records,...(records.length!==loaded.file.records.length?{cleanup:'needed' as const}:{})};}
  catch{return {kind:'unavailable',message:unavailableMessage};}
 });}
 recover(tokenInput:string):Promise<LearningDraftRecoverResult>{
  const token=parseLearningDraftRecoveryToken(tokenInput);
  return this.serialize(async()=>{
   const bytes=await this.invalidSource(token),backupBasename=`learning-drafts-recovery-${randomUUID()}.json`;
   const backup=await open(join(this.options.directory,backupBasename),'wx',0o600);
   try{if(Buffer.isBuffer(bytes))await backup.writeFile(bytes);else await this.copyOversized(token,backup);await backup.sync();}finally{await backup.close();}
   await this.syncDirectory();
   const epoch=randomUUID();
   await this.write({schemaVersion:2,epoch,records:[]},async()=>{await this.invalidSource(token);});
   return {kind:'recovered',epoch,backupBasename};
  });
 }
 cleanup():Promise<LearningDraftCleanupResult>{return this.serialize(async()=>{
  const loaded=await this.load();if(loaded.kind==='unavailable')throw Error(loaded.message);
  const records=await this.survivingRecords(loaded.file.records),removed=loaded.file.records.length-records.length;
  if(removed===0)return {kind:'cleaned',epoch:loaded.file.epoch,removed};
  const retained=new Set(records.map(record=>learningDraftTaskId(record.owner))),absent=new Set(loaded.file.records.map(record=>learningDraftTaskId(record.owner)).filter((taskId):taskId is string=>taskId!==undefined&&!retained.has(taskId)));
  const epoch=randomUUID();
  await this.write({schemaVersion:2,epoch,records},async()=>{
   for(const taskId of absent)if(await this.options.lookupTask(taskId)!==undefined)throw Error('Deleted task cleanup changed. Read its current status and try again.');
  });
  return {kind:'cleaned',epoch,removed};
 });}
 save(ownerInput:LearningDraftOwner,slotInput:string,expectedEpochInput:string,expectedRevision:number,valueInput:LearningDraftValue|null):Promise<LearningDraftSaveResult>{
  // Parse and detach before queueing so caller mutation cannot change a pending write.
  const owner=structuredClone(parseLearningDraftOwner(ownerInput)),slot=parseLearningDraftSlot(slotInput),expectedEpoch=parseLearningDraftEpoch(expectedEpochInput),value=structuredClone(parseLearningDraftValue(valueInput,owner,slot));
  return this.serialize(async()=>{
   if(!Number.isSafeInteger(expectedRevision)||expectedRevision<0||expectedRevision===Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)throw Error('Draft revision is invalid.');
   const loaded=await this.load();if(loaded.kind==='unavailable')throw Error(loaded.message);
   if(loaded.file.epoch!==expectedEpoch)return {kind:'stale-epoch',epoch:loaded.file.epoch};
   const key=learningDraftKey(owner,slot),current=loaded.file.records.find(record=>learningDraftKey(record.owner,record.slot)===key)??null;
   const allowed=()=>!isTaskLearningDraftOwner(owner)?Promise.resolve(slot===LOCAL_TASK_DRAFT_SLOT):value===null?this.validTask(owner.taskId):this.validOwner(owner,slot,value);
   if((value===null&&!current)||!await allowed())throw Error('The practice answer is no longer available.');
   if((current?.revision??0)!==expectedRevision)return {kind:'conflict',epoch:loaded.file.epoch,current};
   const record:LearningDraftRecord={owner,slot,revision:expectedRevision+1,value};
   const records=loaded.file.records.filter(item=>learningDraftKey(item.owner,item.slot)!==key);records.push(record);
   const file:LearningDraftFile={schemaVersion:2,epoch:loaded.file.epoch,records};
   const beforeReplace=async()=>{if(!await allowed())throw Error('The practice answer is no longer available.');};
   if(records.length>LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.entries||Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(file))>LEARNING_DRAFT_LIMITS.fileBytes){
    const retained=loaded.file.records.filter(item=>item.value!==null);
    if(retained.length===loaded.file.records.length)throw Error('Unfinished practice storage is full.');
    // Dropped tombstones require a fresh namespace so delayed revision-zero writes remain stale.
    const epoch=randomUUID();await this.write({schemaVersion:2,epoch,records:retained},beforeReplace);
    return {kind:'stale-epoch',epoch};
   }
   await this.write(file,beforeReplace);return {kind:'saved',epoch:file.epoch,record};
  });
 }
 purgeTask(taskId:string):Promise<void>{return this.serialize(async()=>{
  parseLearningDraftTaskId(taskId);
  const loaded=await this.load();if(loaded.kind==='unavailable')throw Error(loaded.message);
  const records=loaded.file.records.filter(record=>learningDraftTaskId(record.owner)!==taskId);
  if(records.length!==loaded.file.records.length)await this.write({...loaded.file,records});
 });}
}
